zh.title: 连接与会话体验修复
items: 手动连接默认只需输入电脑显示的 8 位连接码；扫码仍作为快捷入口，多台电脑同时等待时才会要求选择目标电脑。
授权界面统一使用“客户端”称呼，准确覆盖浏览器、Android 和 iPhone / iPad App。
项目列表不再默认暴露电脑完整路径；可在“配置信息”中按需查看路径，并仅修改本 App 内的项目显示名称。
修复创建会话与项目配置弹窗关闭时可能出现的 Flutter 红屏，并加固抽屉切换和项目列表重排时的组件生命周期。
新增任务通知、图片附件、会话草稿隔离与移动端 Kimi / Codex 工作台一致性改进。

en.title: Connection and session reliability fixes
items: Manual connection now asks only for the 8-digit code shown on the computer; scanning remains the shortcut, and a computer chooser appears only when several computers are waiting.
Authorization screens now use the broader client terminology to accurately cover browsers, Android, and the iPhone / iPad app.
Project lists no longer expose full computer paths by default; Configuration reveals the path on demand and can rename only the project's local display name in this app.
Fixed Flutter error screens that could appear when closing the create-session or project-configuration dialog, and hardened drawer transitions and project-list reordering.
Added task notifications, image attachments, per-session draft isolation, and mobile Kimi / Codex workbench parity improvements.
